The Nordic insights report is now the **landing page** of the analysis book.

Render and browse it from `rse-book/`:

```bash
cd rse-book
quarto render
```

Then open `_book/index.html`.

Published site: [https://nordic-rse.github.io/rse-survey-2026/](https://nordic-rse.github.io/rse-survey-2026/)

The source lives in [`rse-book/index.qmd`](rse-book/index.qmd), with plotting helpers in [`RSE_survey_insights_helper/`](RSE_survey_insights_helper/).
